title: Oven Roasted Slovakian Chickpeas Lasagna
description: A pescatarian-friendly Slovakian dish featuring chickpeas, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a fresh and cheesy twist, and a yuzu cure for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ricotta cheese, yuzu juice, salt, and pepper.
Stir in the chopped parsley and set the cheese mixture aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chickpeas.
Roast the chickpeas in the oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a large baking dish, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the cheese layer.
Spread half of the remaining cheese mixture over the noodles.
Add the roasted chickpeas and half of the shredded mozzarella on top of the cheese layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the remaining cheese mixture, and finally the remaining mozzarella.
Top the lasagna with the grated parmesan and bake for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
